QuestInfo.name: Enjoying the Wait 1
QuestInfo.0: It's hard to believe, but this is another world called Maple World. Speak with #bGrendel the Really Old#k for details.
QuestInfo.1: The request to collect bird eggs while you wait for Grendel the Really Old is ridiculous, but it might be better than just sitting around. Defeat some #bSparrows#k and collect #b10 Eggs#k.Go visit #bWindy Place#k and #bWhere the Birds Chirp#k.
QuestInfo.2: You have the #b10 Eggs#k, but Grendel the Really Old still has not arrived. Speak to Three Moon again.

0.msg: So this Grendel guy can explain everything, right? Maybe I should go to him, then. I'm kinda in a hurry.

item.0: You need to be patient and you need more eggs. At least 10.
